label: Count Objects (1-20) (Visual)

defects.what: Objects are drawn at about 2-3 mm (tiny stars/triangles/squares), far below the 9 mm counting-picture minimum (WS 11.2); a K pupil cannot count 16-19 objects that small without losing place (H2).
defects.fix: Draw every counting object at 9-12 mm in rows of 5 with the 1.5 mm subitising gap (RP-21); if 20 objects do not fit, use a 2-column grid with fewer items per page.

defects.what: Object size changes from cell to cell (item 1 dots 5 mm, item 5 dots 3 mm, item 8 stars 2 mm) and the "Answer:" line jumps up or down with the picture height (items 2, 13), so the routine is not predictable (AX-4).
defects.fix: Fix one object size per section and pin the answer box to the same place in every cell.

defects.what: Answer slot is a long "Answer: ____" rule; a count wants a square answer box beside the picture as in the approved K mock-up.
defects.fix: Use a 16-20 mm square answer box at the right of each cell.

defects.what: Three of 21 items are a single object (answer 1); the set is padded with trivial items while 11-20 (the hard part of "1-20") gets 9 items.
defects.fix: Distribute counts across the band, at most one item of 1-2, and include teen counts 11-20 in ten-and-some arrangements.

defects.what: Teen counts are not arranged as a ten plus ones (no 5-5 grouping gap), so the picture does not teach the ten structure.
defects.fix: Arrange 11-20 objects as two rows of 5, a gap, then the extra ones (RP-21).

defects.what: Page 2 holds 6 items in the top third and is about 65 % empty, with a mid-page footer at y = 383 (H5).
defects.fix: Rebalance to 16 items (2 x 8 one-symbol grid) on one page or two equal pages.

defects.what: Rows are unequal in height and cells have no borders; the free area is at the bottom of the page, not in the cells.
defects.fix: Use a regular bordered grid with equal cells and ≥ 40 % free area per cell.

defects.what: No page frame: no strand tab (Level · strand · sheet id), no "I Can ..." title (title is the skill label "Count Objects (1-20) (Visual)"), no instruction line above the grid, plain "1." labels instead of quiet letters or black number tabs, footer "Maths Quest Pro" instead of the 7 pt teacher footer (WS 8.1, 7.2-7.3).
